stories.title: Fix scanner.py 422 crash
stories.description: get_price_ohlcv(): try/except requests.HTTPError 422 → print '[SKIP] No OHLCV for {token_address}' + return []. Test with NANSEN_MOCK=0 python3 scripts/run_pipeline.py (must skip VIRTUAL without crash).
acceptance: NANSEN_MOCK=0 python3 scripts/run_pipeline.py | grep -q 'SKIP.*VIRTUAL' && echo 'PASS' || echo 'FAIL'
